🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 16, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a sextile to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Neptune have just closed a conjunction, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, meeting no resistance. Cardinal fire: beginning costs almost nothing. Mars has been out of Cancer for four weeks now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Mercury opposes you from Scorpio, and the account has two columns. Fixed earth pays to hold on. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. Moon in Sagittarius mirrors you, and the mirror keeps its own figures. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Mercury has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Sagittarius, where nothing is owed to it. Venus trines you from Scorpio, and what you hold finds words unforced. Water moves first here, and first is enough. Mars let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Since Sun crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Sagittarius, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable earth: keeping options is the expense. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon in Sagittarius opens a gap you have to step into. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Mercury crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable fire: the two accounts collapse into one. The sextile to Mercury that held three weeks ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Mercury in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. A week ago Saturn was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon sextiles you from Sagittarius: help that waits to be asked for. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. From Sagittarius, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Water that changes shape, charged for each shape. It arrived inside the last seven days.
